description: This file defines a configuration class for Vertex AI Imagen Image Edit, including methods to prepare requests, handle responses, and manage environment variables for the Vertex AI API.

classes.name: VertexAIImagenImageEditConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Vertex AI Imagen Image Edit, inheriting from BaseImageEditConfig and VertexLLM, providing methods for request transformation, response handling, and environment validation.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns the list of supported parameters for the OpenAI API that this class supports for Vertex AI.

methods.description: Maps OpenAI style parameters to Vertex AI-specific parameters, filtering and transforming as needed.

methods.name: Optional[str] _resolve_vertex_project(self)
methods.description: Resolves the Vertex AI project ID from various sources.

methods.name: Optional[str] _resolve_vertex_location(self)
methods.description: Resolves the Vertex AI location from environment variables or secret manager.

methods.name: Optional[str] _resolve_vertex_credentials(self)
methods.description: Resolves credentials needed for Vertex AI from environment variables or secrets.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates environment variables and tokens required for Vertex AI predictions.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, model: str, api_base: Optional[str], litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for Vertex AI prediction based on model and environment.

methods.name: Tuple[Dict[str,Any],Optional[RequestFiles]] transform_image_edit_request( self, model: str, prompt: str, image: FileTypes, image_edit_optional_request_params: Dict[str, Any], litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Prepares the request payload and files for an image edit operation via Vertex AI.

methods.name: ImageResponse transform_image_edit_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: Any, )
methods.description: Processes the raw response from Vertex AI and extracts image data.

methods.name: str _map_size_to_aspect_ratio(self, size: str)
methods.description: Converts resolution size strings into aspect ratio labels.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _prepare_reference_images( self, image: Union[FileTypes, List[FileTypes]], image_edit_optional_request_params: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Prepares reference images, including masks, into the format expected by Vertex AI.

methods.name: bytes _read_all_bytes( self, image: Any, depth: int = 0, max_depth: int = DEFAULT_MAX_RECURSE_DEPTH )
methods.description: Recursively reads image data into bytes from various input types, supporting files, streams, and paths.
